verdict.rationale: RUN documents running payroll online, by phone, or in a mobile app. It also documents AI import of employee hours from existing timesheet files, AI error flagging before mistakes take effect, and automatic deposit on payday. Together these imply an end-to-end cycle, but the evidence never describes a single guided flow with a review-and-preview-totals step before submission. Missing for 10: a documented hours/earnings review screen, a payroll totals preview before submit, a description of the single-flow submission, and hands-on corroboration.
